method: Separate depth-3 decision trees for currency bearish, US stock bearish and crypto bullish forecasts. Use adaptive chart features, lagged asset-local score and historical 6/12-month returns. Fit binary outcome splits on older data, minimum 100 samples per leaf; select a validation-only score threshold with adaptive's gates; test later year. Ties are misses. Replayed comparators share eligible observations, but select different calls.
limitations: Repeatedly inspected historical data and research selection; this is not an independent or prospective test. Uncertainty intervals do not include model selection.
Overlapping outcomes and shared market shocks reduce independent information. Current listing universe mostly omits delisted assets; local history requirements narrow eligibility.
Yahoo crypto differs from Binance. No fees, taxes, dividends, slippage, or executable same-close entry; this model is not deployed.
